Scope and player interaction

Server-owned AI moves a capsule over actual 3D walkable surfaces. Use AIController, Behavior Tree, Blackboard, AI Perception and navigation before considering a second decision framework.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase08committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Idle → Patrol → Alert → Pursue → Attack → ReturnToLeash → Evade → Defeated → Corpse

WBP_TargetFrame observes results from ARPGEnemyAIController. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Enemy_Mossfang. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
Blackboard: TargetActor, HomeLocation, PatrolIndex, HasLOS, InAttackRange, IsEvading
ThreatByCharacterId: server-only finite nonnegative values; eligible source context
PerceptionRadiusCm=1800; LeashRadiusCm=3000; HomeLocation authoritative spawn
AttackDefinitionIds: authored choices with range/cooldown/role restrictions
LastReachableTargetPosition: transient navigation hint, not permission to attack through walls
FactionDisposition: Passive|Defensive|Aggressive rules; boss overrides explicit

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
ARPGEnemyAIControllerImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_TargetFrameLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
AddThreat(VerifiedCombatEvent) -> Updated|Ignored; server only
SelectThreatTarget() -> Actor|None; valid alive/reachable/leash candidates
RequestAttackFromAI(AbilityId, Target) -> Accepted|Cooldown|NoLOS; uses same ability validation
EnterEvade(Reason) -> Resetting; cancel combat/credit under declared reset policy
ResetToHome(SpawnGeneration) -> Ready|NavigationFailure

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Spawn controller possesses the enemy Character and initializes definition, ASC and Blackboard before running the Behavior Tree.
  2. Perception updates candidate targets; a target selector combines disposition/threat/leash rules and writes one Blackboard TargetActor.
  3. Behavior Tree moves with navigation, chooses attack when range/LOS/cooldown permit, and calls the same authoritative ability stack as player attacks.
  4. Damage/healing contribution emits verified threat; threat does not come from client UI selection or proximity alone.
  5. If target is unreachable/outside leash or combat stalls, enter Evade: cancel attacks/projectiles owned by this reset, clear threat/credit according to policy and navigate home.
  6. After reaching a valid home floor, restore health under reset policy and resume patrol. Defeated state instead hands off to the unique defeat/loot record; it cannot evade back to life after rewards committed.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create BB_Enemy and BT_Enemy with priority branches Defeated, Evade, Combat, Patrol, Idle. Create project BT tasks only for domain operations not supplied by standard movement/wait tasks.
  2. Create BP_EnemyAIController from ARPGEnemyAIController and assign perception plus Blackboard/BehaviorTree references. Configure sensing affiliations deliberately.
  3. BP_Enemy_Mossfang derives from the native enemy Character, uses a capsule, CharacterMovement, ASC and noncolliding sprite presentation. Set AI Controller Class and auto-possession policy for spawned AI.
  4. Place NavMeshBoundsVolume over all intended test surfaces and build navigation. Press the Editor navigation visualization toggle and inspect ramps, bridge decks, stairs and gaps.
  5. Place Encounter_WestRoad with DA_Enemy_Mossfang, a home point and patrol route. Test melee pursuer, ranged sentry and passive wildlife as definition variants, not separate copied AI stacks.
  6. Use StateTree only after a measured maintenance/performance comparison and a migration decision; do not run two behavior authorities on one enemy.

Reopen Phase08 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Rillmere / Encounter_WestRoad / LeashBoundary / Bridge. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Target behind unreachable ledge -> pursue/reposition or evade; no platformer X-axis chase heuristic.
Player kites beyond leash -> encounter resets safely and no reward is emitted.
Target disconnects -> choose remaining valid threat or reset; no null-target attack.
Two clients damage one enemy -> server threat/credit are consistent; client order does not determine final ledger identity.
Navmesh missing on bridge -> NavigationFailure diagnostic; do not teleport through geometry to hide the error.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Radius/timing values are initial fixtures. Proposed stalled-path timeout 5 seconds with bounded retries. Threat coefficients and healer threat need party tests; no assumption of MMO-scale AI count.

Use server AI debugger/Blackboard inspection and threat logs gated to development. Replicate only readable intent/telegraphs and movement, not the entire Behavior Tree or threat map.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
